result.title: SettleSplat: Monocular Gaussian Mapping under In-View Scene Changes
result.summary: Online 3D Gaussian mapping enables fast and high-fidelity novel view synthesis, with broad applications in augmented reality, robotics, and autonomous systems. However, many current methods assume static scenes or filter out dynamics as outliers. In this paper, we study in-view scene changes where objects are manipulated in front of the camera within a single online sequence, unlike prior works that detect changes outside the camera view or between separate captures. This setting entangles transient and persistent dynamics, as objects can be distractors while moving and persistent once they settle. While recent studies start to address distractors by removing them for clean static background, in-view scene changes remain underexplored. To resolve this, we present SettleSplat, a monocular mapping system that maintains up-to-date 3D Gaussian maps under such changes. Specifically, we lift coarse per-pixel uncertainty into Gaussian dynamicity field, then prune transient ones. For persistent changes, we derive geometric contradictions weighted by parameter-free rendered depth uncertainty to separate true changes from under-optimized regions. On Bonn and Co-Fusion, SettleSplat achieves consistent 3D Gaussian maps, outperforming current baselines on both full images and change regions while maintaining comparable speed.

AI.brief_summary: SettleSplat 研究单目在线序列中相机视野内的物体被搬动所造成的场景变化，在线维护 3D 高斯地图：将逐像素不确定性提升为高斯动态性场以剪除瞬态物体，并用无参数渲染深度不确定性加权的几何矛盾区分持久变化与欠优化区域。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不确定性加权区分真实变化与未充分优化区域」的证据判别思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、以及 latent 状态里陈旧信息剔除与更新的机制设计提供类比线索，可供核查。
